## Flutter, Mobile App & AI Automation Services | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/services/
Flutter and native mobile app development, n8n and AI agent automation, and technical leadership. Contract and full-time, Hamburg and remote across the UK and EU.
Services: Flutter development, AI automation and technical leadership
One senior engineer, accountable end to end. Based in Hamburg and working remotely with UK and EU teams on CET.
Flutter and mobile app development
I design, build and release cross-platform apps in Flutter and Dart, and native apps in Swift and Kotlin where it makes sense. Typical work: new product builds, feature squads inside an existing team, performance and crash fixes, and store submission and release pipelines.
Flutter, Dart, Provider, Riverpod, GoRouter
iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin)
Firebase, REST APIs, RevenueCat subscriptions
Unit, widget and integration testing; GitHub Actions and Xcode Cloud CI/CD
AI agents and n8n automation
I build n8n workflows and MCP-based AI agents that run reliably: schema-validated tool calls, retries, error handling and monitoring. Good for back-office processes, content and data pipelines, and internal tools.
Technical leadership and audits
Fifteen years of shipping production apps. I can lead a mobile team, review an app's architecture and release process, or take over a struggling codebase and stabilise it.
Engagement
Contract and freelance (day rate, on-site or hybrid in Hamburg, or remote) and open to full-time roles. Get in touch with scope and timing.

## About David Miller, Lead Flutter Developer in Hamburg | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/about/
David Miller is a lead Flutter developer in Hamburg with 15 years in mobile and 7 shipping Flutter, now also building AI agents and n8n automations.
About David Miller
Lead Flutter developer in Hamburg with 15 years in mobile and 7 shipping Flutter. Now also building AI agents and n8n automations with the same release discipline.
I have shipped production apps for FIFA, Porsche, Adidas, Canon, F1 TV, OneFootball and Standard Chartered, worked with IBM on an Android app for the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team and with Accedo in Stockholm, and I build my own products, including ReelMatch, Hushdo and the open-source FlutterFix, plus n8n and AI agent automations. I studied at Northumbria University and am completing WBS Coding School's AI Agents programme.
How the agency works
Digital Space Agency began as a partnership. It is now just me, supported by AI agents and n8n automations that run the back office and speed up engineering. You always deal directly with the person doing the work, and every release is reviewed and tested by me.
Availability
Open to contract engagements and to the right full-time role. Hamburg on-site or hybrid, or remote for UK and EU teams on CET.
Elsewhere
LinkedIn · GitHub · info@dsa.team

## FIFA App Developer | Digital Space Agency

Home / Work / FIFA
Client work · Sport
FIFA mobile app development
Mobile app development for FIFA.
The 2014 FIFA World Cup in Brazil is the most-watched sporting event on earth, and the official app had to handle the traffic of a final.
About the brand
The official FIFA World Cup app was released in December 2013 and fully updated for the 2014 tournament in Brazil. It gave fans live coverage of all 64 games, news, photos and videos, real-time voting for Man of the Match, tournament stats, the FIFA/Coca-Cola World Ranking and scores from 197 leagues, plus a social feed for FIFA's Global Stadium. Source: Wikipedia. Source: FIFA press release, 12 June 2014.
www.fifa.com
My role
I worked on the official FIFA World Cup app for Brazil 2014, and spent six weeks in Brazil during the tournament.
What I built
Worked on the official FIFA World Cup app for Brazil 2014 and spent six weeks in Brazil during the tournament.
The app covered live coverage of all 64 games, news, photos and video, real-time Man of the Match voting, stats, the FIFA/Coca-Cola World Ranking and scores from 197 leagues.
Outcome
Delivered for the 2014 World Cup in Brazil, with six weeks on site.

Mobile app development for Porsche.
Unlocking a car from a phone is a small action with a large trust problem. Porsche Car Connect was one of the early connected-car apps, in the years when remote services were new.

Porsche Car Connect is the connected-car service for Porsche vehicles, used through the Porsche mobile app. Its Remote, Safety and Security services let owners lock and unlock the car, control the climate, manage electric charging and see vehicle data such as mileage, tyre pressure and range. ## Adidas Training by Runtastic App Developer | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/adidas/
Adidas Training by Runtastic app for the Facebook Portal TV device. Runtastic is the fitness app brand from Adidas, now sold as the adidas Running and adidas Training apps.
Home / Work / Adidas Training by Runtastic
Client work · Sportswear and fitness
Adidas Training by Runtastic mobile app development
Adidas Training by Runtastic app for the Facebook Portal TV device.
A workout app that has to work from the sofa, across the room, on a TV-sized screen and with nothing but a remote or voice. Adidas Training by Runtastic on Facebook Portal TV was an exercise in designing for a device nobody holds.
About the brand
Runtastic is the fitness app brand from Adidas, now sold as the adidas Running and adidas Training apps. They track runs, walks, hikes and cycling and offer workouts, and logged activities earn adiClub points. Adidas is a German sportswear company headquartered in Herzogenaurach. Source: Wikipedia. Source: adidas Running on Google Play.
www.runtastic.com
My role
I built the Adidas Training by Runtastic app for the Facebook Portal TV device.
What I built
Ported the Adidas Training Android app to Android TV on Facebook Portal TV as the sole developer, in partnership with Adidas and Facebook.
Built video playback and download, guided timed workouts and training plans personalised to the user's body data, with fitness tracking and rewards.
Architecture and approach
Android TV UI built for the ten-foot experience: focus handling, large type and remote or voice navigation.
Video playback and offline download of workout content.
A workout engine for guided, timed sessions that drives video, timers and tracking together.
Sole-developer delivery: architecture, build pipeline and release owned end to end.
Hard problems
Designing for focus, not touch
Android TV has no touch. Every screen needed predictable focus order, so a person can start a workout with a remote or voice from across a room.
Reusing a phone app on a TV
The mobile app's logic had to be adapted to a different input model, screen size and device, without forking the product.
Outcome
Delivered in four months, November 2020 to March 2021.
Shipped on a new smart-display TV device for Adidas and Facebook.
Tech and keywords
Android TV
Android

Sole developer

Lifecake, the family photo and video app owned by Canon.

## F1 TV App Developer | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/f1-tv/
Mobile app for the Formula 1 streaming service. The F1 TV app is the official Formula 1 streaming app.
Home / Work / F1 TV
Client work · Sport and streaming
F1 TV mobile app development
Mobile app for the Formula 1 streaming service.
Race fans watch twenty on-board cameras while the timing screen keeps pace to the tenth of a second. Making a live video stream and a live data feed agree with each other on a phone was the interesting part of F1 TV.
About the brand
The F1 TV app is the official Formula 1 streaming app. With a subscription it streams every session live and on demand, with onboard cameras, live team radios, live timing and coverage of support series such as F2 and F3. It runs on mobile, the web and TV platforms. Source: Wikipedia. Source: F1 TV Pro.
f1tv.formula1.com
My role
I worked on the F1 TV mobile app.
What I built
Led a five-person iOS and Android team delivering the mobile and video-on-demand features of the official F1 TV app, working with product, backend, video and mobile teams.
Built live video for F1 TV Pro: live races with all 20 driver on-board cameras, dual-stream live video, timing synchronisation and content scheduling.
Stayed hands-on in production code while leading mobile architecture discussions with client and technical stakeholders.
Architecture and approach
Native Android and iOS clients sharing one product backlog and one release train.
Live and VOD video playback driven by a content schedule, so sessions appear and go live at the right moment.
A timing layer that keeps lap-time data aligned with the video position, including when two streams run side by side.
Code review, automated testing and CI/CD release processes across the product, backend, video and mobile teams.
Hard problems
Keeping data and video in step
Live video and live timing data travel separately. The client had to keep them aligned so what the timing screen shows matches what the viewer is watching, including with two streams on screen.
Many streams, one screen
F1 TV Pro offers every driver's on-board camera. Dual-stream playback means two video pipelines on a phone, with the buffering, battery and bandwidth cost that brings.
Outcome
500,000+ Android installs in 2019.
800+ hours of archive content available by 2020.
Delivered as Mobile Lead, June 2019 to March 2020.
Tech and keywords
Android
iOS
Kotlin
Mobile architecture
Technical leadership
Live streaming
VOD
Adaptive video
Timing synchronisation
Code review
CI/CD
Team lead
Quick facts
App: F1 TV
Category: Sport and streaming
Built by: David Miller, Digital Space Agency, Hamburg
Type: Client work

## OneFootball App Developer | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/onefootball/
Mobile app for one of the world's largest football media platforms. The OneFootball app is a free football app for iOS and Android with live scores, news, notifications, statistics and video, including live streams and highlights from selected competitions.
Home / Work / OneFootball
Client work · Sport and media
OneFootball mobile app development
Mobile app for one of the world's largest football media platforms.
OneFootball reports more than 100 million monthly active users. Putting a shop inside an app that size means every pixel has to match the design system and every product, price and promotion has to change without shipping a new release.
About the brand
The OneFootball app is a free football app for iOS and Android with live scores, news, notifications, statistics and video, including live streams and highlights from selected competitions. OneFootball is based in Berlin. Source: Wikipedia. Source: OneFootball on Google Play.
onefootball.com
My role
I worked on the OneFootball mobile app.
What I built
Permanent role (Jan 2025 to Feb 2026): delivered OneFootball's Flutter e-commerce storefront, bringing merchandise purchasing into the consumer app.
Contract role at Stadion (May to Nov 2024): built the Flutter commerce functionality behind the OneFootball Fan Shop, launched in Germany in October 2024 with 11teamsports Group to more than a million German users.
Built supporting backend and internal tooling for sale items, promotions and time-limited campaigns.
Architecture and approach
Flutter Add-to-App: Flutter modules embedded in established native iOS and Android apps, so new commerce screens shipped without rewriting the existing app.
A private, reusable Flutter package that supports merchandise from multiple suppliers through one common commerce implementation.
Melos-based monorepo with trunk-based development and modular package boundaries.
GraphQL for product and order data, Stripe for in-app payments and order processing.
Remote configuration of products, stock and promotions, so merchandising changes need no app release.
Production UI built against OneFootball's design system across two codebases with different architectures and release processes.
Hard problems
Two codebases, two release processes
The shop spanned the Stadion and OneFootball codebases. The answer was a versioned private package with a clear public API, so each host app could adopt releases on its own schedule.
Flutter inside a native app
Add-to-App means sharing navigation, authentication state and lifecycle between native hosts and Flutter engines while keeping start-up and memory in check.
Holding quality while moving fast
Automated test coverage was held at 98%, with a GitHub check that rejects any push that lowers it.
Outcome
Fan Shop launched in Germany in October 2024 to 1M+ users.
Storefront delivered into a platform reporting 100M+ monthly active users (2022).
98% automated test coverage enforced in CI.
Tech and keywords
Flutter
Dart
Add-to-App
Melos
Monorepo
Trunk-based development
GraphQL
Stripe
E-commerce
Private packages
Design system
Remote config
CI/CD
Test coverage
Quick facts
App: OneFootball
Category: Sport and media
Built by: David Miller, Digital Space Agency, Hamburg
Type: Client work

## Shoal for Standard Chartered App Developer | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/standard-chartered/
Shoal, a sustainable savings app built with Standard Chartered: savings pots backed by a green and social project portfolio. Shoal is a mobile savings app where people earn interest through Savings Pots while their money is referenced against a global portfolio of green and social projects.
Home / Work / Shoal for Standard Chartered
Client work · Fintech
Shoal for Standard Chartered mobile app development
Shoal, a sustainable savings app built with Standard Chartered: savings pots backed by a green and social project portfolio.
A savings app has to feel simple while handling account opening, identity and money movement. Shoal added a second challenge: a short engagement and a release date that did not move.
About the brand
Shoal is a mobile savings app where people earn interest through Savings Pots while their money is referenced against a global portfolio of green and social projects. The sustainable asset portfolio is managed by Standard Chartered, and the app shows the CO2e avoided and clean water generated by each saver's pots. Source: Wikipedia. Source: Shoal.
www.shoalapp.com/
My role
I worked on the Shoal app for Standard Chartered, in a regulated financial product where testing and release discipline matter.
What I built
Delivered Shoal for Standard Chartered Ventures, through Hi Mum! Said Dad, as the solo Flutter developer, taking the app over the line to release in a short engagement (January 2022).
Built onboarding, account setup and deposit features, with AWS Cognito authentication.
Architecture and approach
Flutter and Dart cross-platform app for iOS and Android.
GraphQL for account and banking operations.
AWS Cognito for sign-up, sign-in and session handling.
Automated testing and CI/CD from the start, so release candidates could be cut with confidence.
Hard problems
Regulated flows with no room for guesswork
Onboarding and deposits touch real money, so each step needed explicit error and empty states, tested before release rather than discovered after.
Getting to release quickly
As the only Flutter developer, the priority was a shippable vertical slice: authentication, account setup and deposits first, polish second.
Outcome
Shoal released: a savings app where Savings Pots are referenced against green and social projects.
Delivered as a solo Flutter developer in a short engagement.
Tech and keywords
Flutter
Dart
GraphQL
AWS Cognito
Fintech
Onboarding
Payments
Automated testing
CI/CD
Release management
Solo developer

## IBM for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 App Developer | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/ibm-mercedes-f1/
Android application for the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, built to a tight deadline through IBM. The Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team app is the team's official mobile app for fans, covering news, analysis, photos and video from inside the Formula One team.
Home / Work / IBM for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1
Client work · Motorsport
IBM for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 mobile app development
Android application for the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, built to a tight deadline through IBM.
A Formula One team does not wait for a fan app. Building the official Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 app through IBM meant a fixed deadline and a brand that is judged to the millisecond.
About the brand
The Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team app is the team's official mobile app for fans, covering news, analysis, photos and video from inside the Formula One team. The team is based in Brackley, England, and won eight consecutive Constructors' Championships from 2014 to 2021. Source: Wikipedia.
www.mercedesamgf1.com
My role
Through IBM, I built an Android application for the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, delivered to a tight deadline.
What I built
Android developer through IBM on the official Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team fan app (2017).
Delivered an Android application to a tight deadline.
Outcome
Android app delivered for the 2017 season.

## Accedo NUVU App Developer | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/accedo/
Nuvu, Ericsson's video-on-demand service for Africa, built as architect and developer through Accedo in Stockholm. Nuvu was Ericsson's first end-to-end subscription video-on-demand service, announced in November 2015 for Africa and marketed with mobile operators, starting with Airtel Nigeria.
Home / Work / Accedo NUVU
Client work · Streaming
Accedo NUVU mobile app development
Nuvu, Ericsson's video-on-demand service for Africa, built as architect and developer through Accedo in Stockholm.
In 2015 most of sub-Saharan Africa could not stream video reliably or cheaply. Nuvu, Ericsson's subscription video service, was designed around that: download overnight when mobile data is cheap, watch offline later.
About the brand
Nuvu was Ericsson's first end-to-end subscription video-on-demand service, announced in November 2015 for Africa and marketed with mobile operators, starting with Airtel Nigeria. Subscribers got around 3,000 local and international titles for a small monthly fee, downloaded at off-peak times and watched offline. Accedo is a global provider of streaming software and services founded in Stockholm. Source: About Accedo. Source: Ericsson launches NuVu, Nov 2015. Source: Nuvu brand and UI design.
www.accedo.tv
My role
I worked as architect and developer on Nuvu, through Accedo, in a fully agile team at Accedo's Stockholm office (2015 to 2016).
What I built
Architect and developer on Nuvu by Ericsson, working for Accedo (2015 to 2016), the agency in a fully agile team at Accedo's Stockholm office.
Nuvu launched as an Android app with a personalised interface, bookmarking and recommendations, and was marketed with operators, starting with Airtel Nigeria.
Architecture and approach
Nuvu's core design: content downloads are scheduled into off-peak network windows on an Android client.
Offline playback: downloaded titles stay watchable for up to 30 days.
Integration with the operator's customer relationship management and payment systems, so billing goes through the carrier.
A content catalogue of around 3,000 local and international films and series for a small monthly fee.
Hard problems
Making expensive data cheap
The service downloads content at off-peak times at no additional data cost, and also supports Wi-Fi. This only works if downloads survive unreliable cellular networks.
Operator billing
Subscriptions had to plug into the carrier's CRM and payment stack rather than a card form, which shapes sign-up, entitlement and renewal.
Outcome
Public launch announced by Ericsson in November 2015, with Airtel Nigeria, a network of more than 30 million subscribers.
Brand identity by Red Bee, an Ericsson company; bespoke UI and design system by PS Fennell.

BBC Good Food mobile app development
Recipe app project.
Recipe apps live in the kitchen: wet hands, a propped-up phone and a timer going. BBC Good Food's app is judged by whether it stays out of your way while you cook.
About the brand
The Good Food: Recipe Finder app (formerly the BBC Good Food app) is an ad-free cooking app with thousands of kitchen-tested recipes, exclusive meal plans, a cook mode and how-to videos. It is separate from the Good Food Magazine app, which is the digital edition of the print magazine. Source: Wikipedia. Source: Good Food app FAQ.

## ReelMatch | My own product by David Miller | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/reelmatch/
Swipe movie trailers, match with friends and decide what to watch. Flutter, Firebase, TMDB and RevenueCat. Live on the App Store and Google Play. ReelMatch is my own app for deciding what to watch together.
Home / Work / ReelMatch
My own product · Entertainment
ReelMatch
Swipe movie trailers, match with friends and decide what to watch. Flutter, Firebase, TMDB and RevenueCat. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
Two people on a sofa, forty minutes of scrolling, and still no film. ReelMatch turns that into a swipe: each person likes what they like, and the app finds what they both want to watch.
What it is
ReelMatch is my own app for deciding what to watch together. You swipe through recommendations in a Tinder-style stack, watch trailers, and match with friends on shared interests.
My role
I designed, built and run ReelMatch end to end, live on the App Store and Google Play.
What I built
Designed, built and run end to end: product, UX, architecture, backend, builds and release on the App Store and Google Play.
A Tinder-style swipe stack of recommendations with trailers, a friends list, shared likes and a match view that shows what two people both want to see.
A free tier and a premium tier with in-app purchases, invitations with referral rewards, and push notifications.
Architecture and approach
Layered architecture: screens and widgets, then providers (ChangeNotifier), then repositories, then services and APIs (Firebase, TMDB, RevenueCat).
Provider for state management and GetIt for dependency injection, with everything registered in one locator.
GoRouter for declarative navigation, with an analytics observer on every route.
Firebase Auth and Firestore for users, likes, friends and recommendations; Remote Config for feature flags; Cloud Messaging for notifications.
Crashlytics and Performance Monitoring in production, plus a custom analytics event schema.
A subscription layer on RevenueCat, with plan limits enforced by a SubscriptionGuard widget and swipe-limit service.
Unit and widget tests mirrored against the lib/ structure with Mockito.
Hard problems
Recommending to users with no history
Cold-start: before a user has ten likes the engine blends popular and genre-based titles. After that it mixes TMDB recommendations seeded from their likes, filtered by genre, language and streaming platform, retries on API failure and de-duplicates across sources.
A production crash in a dependency
Crashlytics showed a fatal AnimationController double-dispose when a swipe was cancelled. I traced it to the swiper package, forked it into the repo with an _isDisposed guard and registered the fix as a dependency override.
Image memory on older phones
A swipe stack is image-heavy. The image cache is capped (200 images, 50 MB), image errors are suppressed and logged separately, and loading goes through a single cached network image widget.
Free vs premium without leaks
Limits are enforced centrally rather than per screen, so a new feature cannot accidentally bypass the paywall.
Outcome
14,000+ downloads across the App Store and Google Play.
Live on both stores with subscriptions, invitations and review-prompt logic.
Continuous delivery through GitHub Actions and Xcode Cloud.

## Hushdo | My own product by David Miller | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/hushdo/
Voice notes that are transcribed, structured and searched entirely on-device with local AI models. Zero server uploads. Early access waitlist open at hushdo.com. Hushdo is my own voice-notes app.
Home / Work / Hushdo
My own product · Productivity
Hushdo
Voice notes that are transcribed, structured and searched entirely on-device with local AI models. Zero server uploads. Early access waitlist open at hushdo.com.
Voice notes are the most private data on your phone, and almost every voice app sends them to a server. Hushdo does the opposite: speech recognition and the language model both run on the device.
What it is
Hushdo is my own voice-notes app. Notes are transcribed, structured and searched entirely on the device using local AI models, with zero server uploads. An early-access waitlist is open at hushdo.com.
hushdo.com
My role
I am designing and building Hushdo as a privacy-first product.
What I built
Designing and building Hushdo end to end: a private, on-device voice-to-tasks app, iOS first and Android second.
Whisper speech-to-text and small quantised language models run locally, so recordings and text never leave the phone.
Architecture and approach
Flutter app generated with Very Good CLI: flavors (development, staging, production), strict lints, localisation and a test setup from day one.
On-device speech recognition with Whisper through sherpa_onnx, and local GGUF language models through llamadart.
Models are downloaded at runtime, never bundled, through a signed manifest in a separate repository, so the app stays small and updates are verified.
A benchmark harness with a pass bar: only profile and release numbers on real phones count for latency, memory and quality.
iOS 16.4+ and macOS 14+ targets.
Hard problems
Fitting a language model on a phone
Choosing a model size and quantisation that is accurate enough to extract tasks from speech and still fast, cool and memory-friendly on real devices. A throwaway spike screen measures this before any feature is built.
Trustworthy model delivery
Models are large and downloaded at runtime. A signed manifest means the app only installs files it can verify.
Outcome
Early-access waitlist open at hushdo.com.
Website and model hosting in separate repositories.

## FlutterFix | Side project by David Miller | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/flutterfix/
Open-source tool that lets testers long-press a bug in a Flutter app, then sends the report to Claude, which opens a pull request with the fix. MIT licensed. FlutterFix is an open-source, MIT-licensed tool for Flutter teams.
Home / Work / FlutterFix
Side project · Developer tools
FlutterFix
Open-source tool that lets testers long-press a bug in a Flutter app, then sends the report to Claude, which opens a pull request with the fix. MIT licensed.
You spot a bug on your phone, nowhere near a computer. Writing it up takes longer than fixing it, so you forget. FlutterFix removes the write-up and the computer: long-press the broken thing and Claude opens a pull request.
What it is
FlutterFix is an open-source, MIT-licensed tool for Flutter teams. A tester long-presses a bug in a running Flutter app, the report goes to Claude, and Claude opens a pull request with the fix.
github.com/digital-space-agency-com/flutterfix
My role
I created and maintain FlutterFix.
What I built
Created and maintain FlutterFix, an open-source MIT-licensed Dart package, widget, receiver and server for Flutter teams.
A tester long-presses the element, types one sentence, and the report is sent with the element, its text, the widget path that built it, a screenshot with the element outlined and a replay of the seconds before.
Architecture and approach
A Flutter widget that resolves the pressed element, outlines it and captures a screenshot and a replay of the preceding seconds.
Two sinks behind one interface: LocalReceiverSink for use at the desk, straight into a running Claude Code session; HttpSink plus OutboxSink for use anywhere.
The cloud route: a Firebase function checks sign-in and a tester list, applies a daily cap and creates a GitHub issue with the screenshot; a GitHub Action then runs Claude, which opens a pull request.
Nothing is merged automatically; your usual checks run on the pull request and you review it in the GitHub mobile app.
Hard problems
Context that makes a fix possible
A screenshot alone is not enough. Attaching the element, its text and the widget chain gives Claude enough context to find the code.
Flaky and slow screens
Replay captures the seconds before the press, so empty lists, slow loads and animation glitches are visible in the report.
Safe by default
Reports are limited to signed-in testers, capped per day and never merge themselves.
Outcome
Open source on GitHub under the MIT licence.
Works at your Mac in about five minutes, or away from it in about an hour of one-off setup.
Tech and keywords

## WBS AI Agents & Automations | AI & automation by David Miller | Digital Space Agency
URL: https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/ai-automations/
n8n workflows and MCP-based AI agents for back-office and engineering work: schema-validated tool calls, retries and monitoring. I build n8n workflows and MCP-based AI agents for back-office and engineering work, and I am completing WBS Coding School's AI Agents programme.
Home / Work / WBS AI Agents & Automations
AI & automation · Automation
WBS AI Agents & Automations
n8n workflows and MCP-based AI agents for back-office and engineering work: schema-validated tool calls, retries and monitoring.
Most small teams lose hours to work that is predictable but not simple: moving data between tools, checking it, and chasing exceptions. I build agents and workflows that do it, with the same release discipline as a shipped mobile app.
What it is
I build n8n workflows and MCP-based AI agents for back-office and engineering work, and I am completing WBS Coding School's AI Agents programme. The same agents and workflows run Digital Space Agency itself.
My role
I design, build and monitor automations for my own studio and for clients.
What I built
n8n workflows and Python-based AI agents for back-office and engineering work, including the agents that run Digital Space Agency itself.
Completed WBS Coding School's AI Agents and Automation programme (July to October 2026): two applied business-workflow prototypes and a final MVP combining n8n, Python, APIs and AI agents to solve a real business problem end to end.
Architecture and approach
n8n for orchestration: triggers, branching, retries and error workflows.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) to give agents controlled access to external tools and data.
Multi-agent collaboration where a planner hands work to specialised agents.
Schema-validated tool calls, retries, idempotent steps and alerts, so a failure is visible and recoverable.
Testing, review and production-readiness applied to workflows, the same as to mobile releases.
Hard problems
Making agents dependable
Models are not deterministic. Reliability comes from narrow tools, validated inputs and outputs, retries and a human in the loop for anything irreversible.
Observability
A silent automation is a risk. Every workflow reports success and failure somewhere a person will see it.
Outcome
Working MVP delivered as the final project of the programme.
Used in my own studio daily.
